title: Taalas HC1 hardwired Llama 3.1 8B AI accelerator delivers up to 17,000 tokens/s
supports: Taalas HC1 stores Llama 3.1 8B weights in a mask-ROM-based array on TSMC 6 nm (~815 mm2), SRAM for KV cache; new base model needs new metal masks (via search snippet); prior art for I-04585

title: Taalas etches AI models onto transistors to rocket boost inference
supports: Hardwired model weights in silicon, vendor-claimed ~17k tokens/s per user (via search snippet); prior art for I-04585

title: China budget-phone production targets raised on recycled DRAM
supports: Chinese smartphone brands reportedly desolder DRAM from used phones/PCs/servers and reuse it in new budget phones during the shortage; reliability flagged as concern (via search snippet); prior art for I-06854

title: Meta will reuse terabytes of DDR4 memory using CXL
supports: Meta built an in-house CXL ASIC (Vistara) to reuse retired DDR4 alongside DDR5; Google also reported DDR4 reuse adapters; no source found for phone LPDDR into CXL expanders (via search snippet); prior art for I-06854/I-08737
